text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haaaa! A good morning to you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How did you spend your day off!? I helped 
keep the peace downtown with Ms. Biko!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
We picked up trash, patrolled…… And even 
did a hero show in the park!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? As class president and 
honor student, I've had quite the 
wonderful and fulfilling holiday!

In her own way, Sakura Bakushin O seems to 
have……enjoyed her holiday!
